Jano' ba' jix duñia' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Koree; mi' dhɨr gu ux; jano' ba' gu ja'tkam bɨx jix duñia' gu noobh; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu jodai'.
Na gu' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu Gɨ'kora' Jawatan gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix gɨ' bhaan bɨx gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ja'tkam bɨtaa'n no'ch chɨbɨɨp bɨtaa'n gu oi'ñga'n tɨɨt.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' tɨɨt dɨppɨr; gio ba' gu jodai' gu Jakob jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr gu Sela; jano' ba'.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu jodai' gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu suudai' kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' tɨ'ya' gu Jawatan Dios tɨ'ya'; gio ba' tɨ'ya' chulhiiñdha' gu gɨ'kora' tɨ'ya'.
Na gu' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu gɨ'kora' bɨx gu oidha'; gio ba' tɨ'ya' bɨɨx gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jix gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios bhaan chɨbɨɨp; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios bhaan jix bhaan atooxkor.
Jano' ba' chiñia' gu ja'tkam jum daa'ñ gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios gu Abraam; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios kutun kavɨk gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' gu ux gu ma'nkam gu Koree; mi' dhɨr jix gɨ' gu Jawatan Dios suuska'n gu suudai' gu chuukug kiicham chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios gu kavɨk xidhuu.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' oidha' gɨ' gu bhóogɨt bɨx gu oidha' gu kavɨk gu Sioon gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook kiicham gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu jodai' gu tasi' gu ux gu kutun.
Na gu' na gu' gu suudai' gu gɨ'kora' gu oidha' jum daa'ñ; gio ba' jix duñia' bɨx.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug jix duñia' jix maa gu chuukug gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha'; gio ba' gu vaak na ja'p gu u'vɨ gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx gu jɨvɨl gu chuukug gu ñi'ook tu' gu takarui' gu Tarsis.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu chuukug gu jodai' buupui kiicham gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ kiicham chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios na ba' bɨɨx tas; mi' dhɨr gu Sela; jano' ba'.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jurtu'nka' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu chuukug bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook gu oidha'; gio ba' bɨx bhai' gu ñi'ook kɨɨ'n.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu kavɨk gu Sioon; gio ba' jix duñia' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Judaa gu ux ñi'ook na jir bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ xikoolh gu Sioon gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' jix duñia' gɨ' vaak.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu i'ii'ñ gu suudai' gu jodai'; na ba' gu jodai' gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Na gu' na gu' dhi' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' jix bhai'x na ba' bɨɨx tas; gio ba' jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm koi'm.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' gu ux na ba' gu ma'nkam gu Koree; mi' dhɨr gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ dhi' gu ja'tkam bɨx; jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx oipichu'.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n na ja'p gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug gampai' bɨɨma'n.
Jano' ba' gu chin tu ñi'ook matda'; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu i'ii'ñ gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' gu oi'ñga'n naak; gio ba' gu jodai' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Na pai' dhuuk gu ux gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tanoolh jix duñia' na pai' dhuuk tu' na cham jir bhai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui'.
Na gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n namkɨm gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu kutun gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n xibhɨk tu' gu chuukug gu Jawatan Dios gu kutun.
Na gu' na gu' gu kutun gu oidha' u'uuk cham jix duñia' mɨɨjidha'; gio ba'.
Na gu tai jix duñia' na ba' bɨɨx tas cham pai' dhuuk gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt.
Na gu' tu' suulhgidha' mamatdagɨm na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu jodai' mi'x dhaas namkɨm.
Jano' ba' jix bhai'x namki' gu vaak ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook na ba' gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' jup tɨɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Gu' gu' gu chio'ñ cham gu suudai' nɨidhat; gio ba' nɨidhim gu vaakax gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' bɨɨx bɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu Sela; jano' ba'.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka't gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' koi'm jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' gu ux gu xibh; jano' ba' gu takarui' xoi'kam gu suudai' tukga'n jix koi.
Na pai' dhuuk cham gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu oi'ñga'n gu oidha' gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt na pai' dhuuk jix bhɨɨ; gio ba' gu Sela; mi' dhɨr.
Na pai' dhuuk cham jum i'obh na pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n oi'ñdha' na pai' dhuuk gu suudai' gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu vaak.
Na gu' na gu' vaak jodai cham jix duñia' cham tu' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan gɇ'kamtu'nda'.
Jano' ba' tu' xoi'kam gu bhóogɨt gu tai gu chuukug tu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ; na pai' dhuuk tu' ka' gu bhóogɨt na pai' dhuuk xoi'kam tu' gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n tattat; gio ba' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tasi' na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ nɨidhat cham gu chuukug nɨidhim gu vaakax gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu ux gu Asap; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu oidha' dɨr gu jodai' gu tas bɨɨx ka'm pai' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu Sioon gu i'ii'ñ gu jodai' tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' ɨlhdham chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios cham gu chuukug; gio ba' gu tai gu takarui' vupui bhaan gu bhóogɨt gu kutun gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai' jix gɨ'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tɨkɨr jiix gu oidha' na ba' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jɨɨgi'ñdham; na jix duu gu chuukug ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tɨkɨr bɨx bhai'; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios jir bɨx bhai'; mi' dhɨr gu Sela; jano' ba'.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu ja'tkam gu chuukug tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu chuukug gu Israeel gu jodai' bhaan tu'; mi' dhɨr tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' cham tu' gu suudai' bhaan makgɨrxi'ñdha' tu' gu ux maa'nkar tai bhaan vupui bhaan tu' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' cham jix bhɨɨ gu vaak ali' vaakax tu' gu oi'ñga'n ɨ'ɨɨr gu jodai'.
Na gu' na gu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu vaakax gu ux gu oi'ñga'n gu vaakax gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' kakasnira' bɨx gu u'uvhig gu kakkavɨk gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ yooxi'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu takarui' bhiogi' cham tu' gu ñi'ook tu'; na gu' gu chuukug oipichu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' no'ñ jugi tu' gu chuukug tutuur i'i gu ɨ'ɨr gu oi'ñga'n ɨ'ɨɨr.
Jano' ba' gu Sakripika gu Jawatan Dios bhai' ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu tanoolh gu chuukug; gio ba' tu' gu ñi'ook tu' nɨidhat.
Ba' jix aa' gu' cham bhai' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na tu a'ga jix bhɨɨ ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu chin.
Na gu' tu' gu ñi'ook sɨlhka'n jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' gu suudai' ɨxkum tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx; gio ba' bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n ka't baasɨ'n.
Jano' ba' gu chin gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ cham bhai' nɨɨn jugi iatda'.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook bhaan xibhɨk; gio ba' bhaan gu mar gu naan gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' dhi' tu'x gu oi'ñga'n tu' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n tɨɨda' gu suudai' tu' na ja'p tu'; mi' dhɨr tu' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt vupui bhaan gu vupui.
Jano' ba' kɇɇkɇ' jano' dhi' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ cham soo'mchulhdhak namkidhat.
Na gu vaak na jix bhai' bhai' ñi'ook gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook tulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; na pai' dhuuk gu ux gu Dabii na pai' dhuuk mi' dhɨr chɨbiapui gu Batseba suudai' u'va gu Nataan jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan; mi' dhɨr mambhɨɨx jix duñia' tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jurtu'nka' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch; jano' ba' jurtu'nka' gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n tu' na cham jir bhai' gu takarui' uañi'ñ.
Na gu' na gu' tu' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' uañi'ñ bɨɨx tas vupui bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu duukam uañi'ñ gu ñi'ook cham bhai' vupui bhaan gu vupui; na gu' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jir bhai' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ux na jix bhai' ñi'ook na jir bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' tu' na cham jir bhai' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook uañi'ñ jix duñia' gu naan.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'r gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' ɨxchuixim gu ñi'ook jugi matda'.
Jano' ba' gu Puripiikame bɨɨx gu ñi'ook jix duñia' na jix bhai'; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n jabook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt bhai' ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duñia' o'oo jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu vupui uañi'ñ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt tu' na cham jir bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu Krea tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tu'.
Jano' ba' cham mi'x juu'ñ vupui bhaan tu'; gio ba' cham gu suudai' tu' jix bhaan gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt tulhiiñdha'; gio ba' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ namkidhat gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' u'ua'tulhdhix gu oi'ñga'n tu'.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tulhiiñdha'; gio ba' jix duñia' nɨɨn bɨx bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan gu jodai' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duñia' gu chin bhai' ñi'ook.
Na gu' na gu' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu maa'nkar tu' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ maa'nkar tai bhaan.
Jano' ba' makgɨrxi'ñdha' gu Jawatan Dios gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ jix bhai'x; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ gu jodai' jix duñia' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu vupui xoi'kam bɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Sioon; gio ba' gu takarui' vaak jodai gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' tu' jix duñia' makgɨrxi'ñdha' bɨx bhai' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu maa'nkar bɨx vaak na jix bhaan; gio ba' jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan ali' vaakax.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; na pai' dhuuk gu Maskuil gu Dabii na pai' dhuuk suudai' u'va gu Doeg gu suudai' jix maa jix duñia' gu Sauul tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu Dabii tu' tɨbiap gu vaak gu Aimelek; jano' ba' gu ux gu oi'ñga'n tu' gu chuukug tu' na cham jir bhai' gu ñi'ook xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu Jawatan Dios gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' gu chuukug nɨɨn; gio ba' na ja'p gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt gu ux iatda'.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' cham bhai' gu oi'ñga'n xoi'kam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n ñiokda' bɨx bhai'; mi' dhɨr gu Sela; jano' ba'.
Jano' ba' dha' bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu chuukug jix bhai'x nɨɨn.
Na ba' gu ux gu jodai' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duñia' na ba' bɨɨx tas; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' tu' jix duñia' jix koi tu' jix duñia' gu oidha' na jix do'ig; mi' dhɨr gu Sela; jano' ba'.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jir bhai' ja'tkam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt bham.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu chio'ñ cham jix dhaas gu Jawatan Dios gu ux gu kavɨk gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n namkɨm gu jodai' tu' na cham jir bhai'.
Gu' gu' tu' dhi' na ja'p gu suudai' gu vaas gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu Jawatan Dios gu takarui' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' tu' gu bhóogɨt na ba' bɨɨx tas gu ux gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tɨɨgɨ' na gu' jix bhai' vupui bhaan jɨɨgi'ñdham.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' bhaan gu Maalat; mi' dhɨr gu Maskuil gu Dabii; jano' ba' jix aa' gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' jix duu jix bhai'x tu' na cham jir bhai'; jano' ba' cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu oi'ñga'n xoi'kam.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios dɨr gu tɨkɨr jix duñia' bhaan gu ma'nkam gu chichio'ñ gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' cham tu'x jai'ch gu kutun gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' maa'n ka't gu bhóogɨt gu suudai'; gio ba' bɨx gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; mi' dhɨr cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu oi'ñga'n xoi'kam cham cham tu'x jai'ch tu' gu suudai' maa'n.
Jano' ba' cham namki' machia' bɨx jix duñia' gu jodai' tu' na cham jir bhai' kua'da' gu ja'tkam na ja'p tu' jugi gu takarui'; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios cham jix duñia' gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' daam gu takarui' pai' cham ka't ɨɨbhi'ñ; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu jodai' o'oo jix duñia' yooxi' bhaan tu'; na gu' jum xibhɨ'ñ na gu' gu takarui' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook chɨkka koi gu Sioon tulhiiñdha' gu Israeel gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu ja'tkam jix duñia' gu Jakob jix duñia' gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' gu chuukug; na pai' dhuuk gu Maskuil gu Dabii na pai' dhuuk tɨɨtɨs gu Sipeos gui'p gu Sauul; jano' ba' cham gu Dabii gu jodai' na jix uam gu kutun gu oidha' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu chuukug gu ux gu tɨɨgɨ' bɨɨx gu suudai' gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu takarui' soi'm; gio ba' gu chuukug gu jodai' gu chin.
Na gu' na gu' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' bhaan tu' jix kavɨk jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' cham jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan; mi' dhɨr gu Sela; jano' ba'.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu Jawatan Dios u'ua'tɨdham; gio ba' gu Jawatan bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt cham bhai' gu takarui'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu ux tu'r.
Jano' ba' gu vaak maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan tu'; na gu' gu bhóogɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na gu' jix bhai'.
Na gu' na gu' tu' gu takarui' bɨx gu chuukug gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu vupui gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr gu Maskuil gu Dabii; jano' ba' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios soi'm cham tu' gu chuukug ñi'ook Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' tu ñi'ook soi'm gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' kuiñcha gu ñi'ook bhaamki'ñdha' gu ux gu ñi'ook cham bhai' ja'tkam; na gu' mi'x juu'ñ bhaan tu' tu' na cham jir bhai' bɨɨx i'iich jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu i'ii'ñ jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook koi'm bhaan tu' jix duñia' gu vaak.
Jano' ba' choo'n gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' tɨɨtɨs bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook tu' jix bhaan dhaas.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' chɨkka koi gu oi'ñga'n na ja'p gioda' gu takarui' tu' gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai'; gio ba' jix koi oidha' jix gaki; mi' dhɨr gu Sela; jano' ba'.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug gu jɨvɨl jix bhai'x gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu takarui' nɨɨn; na gu' buupui gu ñi'ook gu takarui' kiicham.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh gu tukaa' gu oi'ñga'n bhaan vaak jodai; gio ba' tu' na cham jir bhai' tu jiim cham tu'x jai'ch tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' cham tu'x jai'ch tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu maa'nkar iatda' cham jix bhai'x gu bhóogɨt.
Na gu' na gu' cham jix duñia' bhaamki'ñdha' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai'; na gu' tu' jix duñia' bhaan tu' gu bhóogɨt na gu' gu ñi'ook gu suudai'.
Gu' gu' tu' gu chio'ñ gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug gu takarui' gu ñi'ook.
Na tɨtda:―Aañ jugi jix bhai'x gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu bhóogɨt chu'p.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug ka't koi'm jix duñia' ko'iix gu vaak; na gu' tu' na cham jir bhai' cham tu'x jai'ch chu'p tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios duuñ; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios u'ua'tɨda'.
Jano' ba' gu xumai gu xibh tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook duuñ; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' gu takarui' bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu i'ii'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan tu'; na gu' jix bɨɨx duu bhaan tu' mui'x.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' dɨr gu ñi'ook pataasa' gu Sela; na gu' cham gu takarui' tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu noobh bhaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na jix bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu oi'ñga'n gu chin gu' bhɨɨ'ñdham cham tu'x jai'ch gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n bɨ'ñdhatu' gu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' mi'x juu'ñ bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia'; gio ba' cham kiicha' na ba' bɨɨx tas gu vaak jir bhai'.

Gu' gu' tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix duu gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt oidha' suudai' gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu chichio'ñ gu oi'ñga'n gu tasi' cham jix duñia' gu tanoolh; gu' cham gu ñi'ook tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' bhaan gioda' jix bhai'x gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug; na pai' dhuuk gu Miktam gu Dabii na pai' dhuuk gu Pilisteos jix duñia' gu Gat; na gu' mambhɨɨx xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na gu' gu chuukug gu chio'ñ; gio ba' jix duñia' jugi gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui' gu tanoolh; na gu' mui'x gu takarui' bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook gu Gɨ'kora' Jawatan.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tanoolh gu takarui' tu' gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu suudai' cham gu oi'ñga'n gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu tanoolh gu takarui'; gio ba' bhaan tu' bɨx gu chuukug na ba' cham bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt jix bhai'x gu chuukug nɨɨrda' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ux tu' na cham jir bhai' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu o'o i'iich gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n tu' jix duñia'; gio ba' gu takarui' suakɨt gu bhóogɨt; mi' dhɨr cham u'uan.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu takarui' gu tanoolh tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' dhi' kakasnira' gu Jawatan Dios gu ux tu'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu suudai'; gio ba' cham gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' gu chio'ñ.
Jano' ba' bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' tu' bopxi'ñ bhai' ñi'ook.
Na gu' na gu' gu takarui' gu oidha' koi'm tɨɨt gu chuukug na ba' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu tasi' gu jodai'.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' bhaan cham gu ñi'ook; na pai' dhuuk gu Miktam gu Dabii na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' vupui bhaan gu Sauul jumpa'n; jano' ba' mambhɨɨx xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios mambhɨɨx xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch tu'; na gu' tu' gu suudai' gu i'ii'ñ ɨkgiga'n gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm gu bhóogɨt gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' duuñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Gɨ'kora' Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' dɨr gu tɨkɨr u'ua'tɨda' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu oi'ñga'n gu Sela; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch tu'r.
Jano' ba' gu oidha' tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' dhi' baas tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu chichio'ñ gu tai; mi' dhɨr gu chuukug u'u kavɨk gu takarui' nɨɨn gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' bhaan gu tɨkɨr gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' bhaan bɨx gu oidha' gɇ'kamtu'nda'.

Jano' ba' jix vɨgɨ jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan tu'; jano' ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' gu vaak; gio ba' gu Sela; mi' dhɨr.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu i'ii'ñ jix duñia'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu jodai' gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu oi'ñga'n gu xibh.
Jano' ba' tu' gu bhóogɨt gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan; gio ba' jix duñia' tu' gu ja'tkam.
Na gu' na gu' jix gɨ' bɨɨx ka'm gu tɨkɨr xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch bɨɨx ka'm tɨbaa'ñ tu'r.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' bhaan gu tɨkɨr gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' bhaan bɨx gu oidha' gɇ'kamtu'nda'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' bhaan cham gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu Miktam gu Dabii; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' tu'r bɨx bhai' gu bhóogɨt jix bhai'x gu ma'nkam gu chichio'ñ.
Jano' ba' va'k bɨɨx gu i'ii'ñ gu jodai' tu' na cham jir bhai'; gio ba' xoi'kam jix duu gu ñi'ook gu noobh gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ dɨr gu takarui'; gio ba' jix duñia' dɨr vook a'gi'ñchu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu maa'nkar namki' nɨidhim gu maa'nkar gu ko'oi; gio ba' na ja'p gu oi'ñga'n jix bhai'x gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ naak.
Na cham gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu oi'ñga'n gu kutun gu ñi'ook ka't.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu oi'ñga'n gu chuukug; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug na ja'p gu suudai' gu takarui' gu kutun; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' ka't gu ñi'ook bapaalh.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt na ja'p gu tasi' gu takarui'; gio ba' na ja'p gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu u'vɨ cham gu jodai' gu tas.
Jano' ba' va'k gu suudai' gu jodai' jo'ii' ko'iix gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' bɨɨx gu suudai'.
Na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' jir bhai' na pai' dhuuk gu chuukug gu jodai'; gio ba' tɨɨt jix duñia' gu ɨ'ɨr cham bhai' ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu chuukug gu chio'ñ; gio ba' gu ñi'ook cham tu'x jai'ch gu i'bhɨ na ba' jir bhai'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook cham tu'x jai'ch gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' bhaan cham gu ñi'ook; na pai' dhuuk gu Miktam gu Dabii na pai' dhuuk bhañ gu Sauul nukadham gu vaak na ba' kooda'; jano' ba' gu suudai' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu chuukug; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' bhaan tu' gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu jodai' tu' na cham jir bhai' gu chuukug gu chichio'ñ gu oi'ñga'n.
Na gu' na gu' gu suudai' gu chuukug gu oidha'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bhaan tu' jix kavɨk cham gu ux uañi'ñ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' uañi'ñ gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham gu suudai' gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n na ba' gu kutun gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai'.

Jano' ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel gu oi'ñga'n na ba' gu bhóogɨt chɨbɨɨp; gio ba' cham cham tu'x jai'ch xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu Sela; jano' ba'.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu xumai jix duñia' na ja'p gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' kiicham.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx gu chin; na gu' gu ñi'ook na gu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr chɨkka gu takarui'.
Gu' gu' tu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt chɨbɨɨp.
Jano' ba' gu kavɨk gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu jodai'; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui' gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' cham koo'nda' na gu' gu ja'tkam cham gu suudai'; gio ba' tu jiim gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx gu kavɨk; mi' dhɨr tu' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios kutun kavɨk chulhiiñdha'.
Jano' ba' gu ux uañi'ñ gu chin gu ux gu ñi'ook; gio ba' ka't ui'ka' gu ux mu'ai gu ñi'ook gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' bɨɨx i'iich jix duñia' cham ka't; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu Jakob bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr gu Sela; jano' ba'.
Jano' ba' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu xumai gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ja'p gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui' kiicham.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug na ba' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n jugi; gio ba' tu' cham gu suudai' vaak jodai.
Jano' ba' gu Yo cham gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu kavɨk gu jodai' gu xibh xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch; na gu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu kutun gu tanoolh gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu maa'nkar gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' jix duñia'; na gu' gu chuukug gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' bhaan gu oi'ñga'n; na pai' dhuuk gu Miktam gu Dabii na ba' gu ñi'ook na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan gu Aram-naaraim bhaan gu Aram gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' gu Joab naaka'n gu Edom gu suudai' gu Salinas gu kutun mambhɨɨx gɨ'; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix bhai'x gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' tu' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt no'ch.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu chuukug gu oidha' gu oi'ñga'n; na gu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook na gu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam gu suudai' tu'x; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ i'i suudai' u'va gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jix maa tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu ux tu'r; gio ba' gu Sela; mi' dhɨr.
Na ba' na ba' namkidhat tɨɨdam dodhia' bɨɨx kɨɨ'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu ux xidhuu; gio ba' tu' gu jodai'; mi' dhɨr gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' gu suudai' gu Sukkot.
Jano' ba' gu Miio gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug gu Manasees; gio ba' gu Epraim gu kavɨk mo'o; mi' dhɨr gu Judaa gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Moab gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' bhaan gu Edom mi'x juu'ñ gu bhóogɨt; mi' dhɨr gu vupui gu jodai' bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' chɨkka jix duñia' kiicham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨkka jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu suudai' jix bhai'x; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n chugi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug bhaan bhaamki'ñdha' gu jodai' tulhiiñdha' gu chichio'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñchuda' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duñia' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' bhaan gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr gu ux gu Dabii; jano' ba' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook; gio ba' soi'm gu jodai'.
Na pai' dhuuk dɨr gu maa'nkar gu oidha' duuñ tu' na pai' dhuuk gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jodai kavɨk gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Na gu' na gu' tu' jix duñia' gu kutun bhi'ñbak gu kavɨk vupui bhaan bhaamki'ñdha'.
Jano' ba' gu Yo gu bhóogɨt vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan na ba' bɨɨx tas; gio ba' dhi' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' iiñat gu oi'ñga'n.
Na gu' na gu' tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios naak gu oi'ñga'n jix maa gu maa'nkar gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh bhaan gu tanoolh gu oi'ñga'n gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu takarui' ka't na ja'p gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' na ba' bɨɨx tas vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch tu'r gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tɨɨgɨ' na ba' bɨɨx tas gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' gu Jedutuun; mi' dhɨr gu ux gu Dabii; jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu suudai' gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' jupaabkamu'n tulhiiñdha'.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' jix kavɨk tulhiiñdha'; gio ba' gu kutun cham gu ñi'ook jix jai'.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx ka'm duuk jix duñia' bhaan gu chio'ñ gu bhóogɨt bɨx gu takarui' gu chuukug na ja'p gu maa'nkar gu ñi'ook na ja'p mia'n jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu duukam; gio ba' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu chin gu ñi'ook gu' jix duñia' ba'k; mi' dhɨr gu Sela; jano' ba'.
Jano' ba' gu i'ii'ñ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu suudai' jix bhai'x; na gu' nɨɨra.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' jix kavɨk tu' tulhiiñdha'; gio ba' gu kutun cham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios u'ua'tɨdham gɇ'kamtu'nda'; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu jodai' na jix uam gu kavɨk gu kutun.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam; gio ba' jix duñia' vupui bhaan gu i'ii'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu ñi'ook; jano' ba' gu Sela; gio ba'.
Jano' ba' gu ux tɨɨda' gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu chichio'ñ gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu chio'ñ; gio ba' gu takarui' bɨx gu takarui' gu ja'tkam ka't gu vupui gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' cham gu jodai' gu ñi'ook tu' gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' cham gu oi'ñga'n; mi' dhɨr tu' jix bhai'x gu i'ii'ñ cham gu suudai' gu i'ii'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gook mui'kim naak dhi'; na gu Jawatan Dios gu kavɨk.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch; na gu' tu' gu ñi'ook maa'n jurtu'nka' tu duukam.

Jano' ba' gu ux gu Dabii kua' oidha' jix gaki gu Judaa; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu chuukug tu'; mi' dhɨr gu oi'ñga'n tu' gu xibh; jano' ba' gu i'ii'ñ juraa'n gu ñi'ook tu' gu chuukug tu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu oidha' jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ cham gu suudai'.
Na ba' na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu kavɨk gɇ'kamtu'nda' na ja'p tu' tu jiim xidhuu.
Na gu' na gu' tutkɨ xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu oidha'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' tu' jix bhai' aa' gu oidha'; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu noobh.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu takarui' gu ñi'ook ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu jodai' tu' jix duñia' gu chin.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook tu' dhim na pai' dhuuk gu jodai' tu' jix duñia' gu tukaa'.
Na gu' na gu' jix duñia' gu chuukug; gio ba' ɨkgiga'n gu oi'ñga'n jix suudai' duu.
Jano' ba' gu i'ii'ñ gu suudai' tu'; gio ba' kɨɨ'n tu' gu ñi'ook.
Gu' gu' na ba' chajaañ jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu kuchii; gio ba' ka't gu maa'nkar gu takarui'.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' ka't gu chuukug no'x gu ñi'ook gu jodai'; na gu' gu chin tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook ka't jix kup.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' gu ux gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook soi'm; jano' ba' jix nukadham gu oidha' ɨɨbhi'ñ bhaamki'ñdha'.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' ɨxchuixim gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai' tu' na cham jir bhai'.
Na jix duñia' nɨɨn na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.
Na ba' na ba' gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n bɨx bhai'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu jodai' cham gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt gu kutun jix duñia' gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt tu ñi'ook; gio ba' chɨkka tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug tu' na cham jir bhai' xoi'kam gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ maa'n na ja'p gu i'ii'ñ jix dhaam suudai'.
Gu' gu' gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' jix bhai'x ka't gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu chuukug bhaan ñiiñio'k; gio ba' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu chichio'ñ jix duñia' tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' jir bhai' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia'; gio ba' tas na jix gɨ' bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' gu ux; mi' dhɨr gu duukam gu Dabii; jano' ba' tu' gu oi'ñga'n bhai' ñi'ook gu Sioon gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook soi'm; gio ba' tu' ɨlhdham bɨx gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' na cham jir bhai' daam; gu' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook tu' uañi'ñka'.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook tu' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu chuukug tu' na ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' duduaka' gu takarui' xoi'kam gu vaak jix bhaan vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx gu bhóogɨt tu'x bɨx bhai' tu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu kutun tulhiiñdha' nɨɨra gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha' gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' gu gɨ' suudai'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu kakkavɨk bɨɨx bɨxchu'x gu ñi'ook gu suudai'.
Na gu oi'ñga'n gu jodai' gu gɨ' suudai' gu jodai' gu oi'ñga'n gu jodai' na jix uam chɨbɨɨp.
Na ba' gu ux gu jodai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu oi'ñga'n kɨɨ'p; gio ba' tu' gu chuukug gu suudai' gu takarui' gu xibh gu xumai.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu oidha' gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu chuukug bɨɨx gɨ' suudai' jiim gu Jawatan Dios jix bhuup gu suudai'; na pai' dhuuk gu jodai' kai'ñ na pai' dhuuk gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui' gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu duukam; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx gu chuukug gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu jodai' na jix uam oidha' tas xoi'kam; gio ba' tɨbaa'ñ gu chuukug gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug bhaan dhi' oidha' jix gaki; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' bhai' ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt kai'ñ; gio ba' gu Dan jiiñak gu jodai' gu suudai' gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' gu duukam; mi' dhɨr gu ux; jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx bhai' ñi'ook bɨx gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' tɨ'ya' gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu tɨɨgɨ'; gio ba' gu suudai' gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu kutun.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu suudai' gu o'o buimɨi gu ux jix gɨ' gu maa'nkar tu' gu ñi'ook obhɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu oidha' tu' jix duñia' tu'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu tɨɨgɨ'; mi' dhɨr gu Sela; jano' ba'.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu jodai' buimɨi gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook bhaan gu ma'nkam gu chichio'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu gɨ' suudai' jix gaki; gio ba' gu ux gɨ' suudai' jiim gu ñi'ook tɨɨt; mi' dhɨr gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx gu kavɨk na ba' bɨɨx tas; gio ba' gu vupui gu suudai' bhaan chɨbɨɨp; mi' dhɨr gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ cham ka't gu jodai'; jano' ba' gu Sela; gio ba'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ja'tkam chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios xoi'kam gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu kutun.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu kutun gu i'ii'ñ gu oidha' cham jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ tɨɨt gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' na gu' tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ja'p gu bhóogɨt jix toja jodai.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' jix vɨgɨ; gio ba' jix dhaas gu chuukug gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu chichio'ñ gu oi'ñga'n jix tɨ'ɨ bhaan gu kutun mo'o; gio ba' ba'k gu tai gu suudai' gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' ba'k gu vaak bɨɨx maa'nkar tai bhaan; gio ba' tu' namkidha' gu oi'ñga'n.
Ba' jix aa' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu chin na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' ka't.
Jano' ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan kai' vaas tu' gu jodai' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu chuukug; gio ba' maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gu vaakax gu ñi'ook ɨ'ɨɨr; mi' dhɨr gu Sela; jano' ba'.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios gu suudai' tu' gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu chin gu oi'ñga'n ka't bɨɨx nɨɨn.
Jano' ba' tu' gu i'ii'ñ gu takarui' tu' tu jiim gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan cham gu ñi'ook.
Gu' gu' gu ñi'ook jix kai gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook ñi'ook Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios cham mi'x juu'ñ soi'm tu' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr gu ux; jano' ba' gu duukam; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch no'ch gu jodai'; mi' dhɨr gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu vupui bhaan no'ch gu Sela.
Na ba' na ba' ka't gu tasi' gu oidha' gu bhóogɨt chɨbɨɨp tulhiiñdha'.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu ja'tkam bɨx.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu suudai' chɨbɨɨp; na gu' gu bhóogɨt gu ja'tkam bɨɨx gu ux gu takarui' gu ja'tkam gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr gu Sela; jano' ba'.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu ja'tkam tu' bhai' ñi'ookdha'.
Jano' ba' gu oidha' maa'n gu i'bhɨ; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha'.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' gu ux gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr gu oi'ñga'n; jano' ba' gu jodai' gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu suudai' gu takarui' gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' na ja'p u'u kavɨk kuubh u'u kavɨk; gio ba' na ja'p gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug vupui bhaan gu tai gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Gu' gu' jir bhai' ja'tkam jix duñia'; gio ba' jix duñia' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' bhai' ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tɨ'ya' gu Jawatan Dios tɨ'ya' gu takarui' gu tɨɨgɨ'; gio ba' jix duñia' jix tɨ'ɨ bhaan gu tɨkɨr gu gɨ'kora' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu takarui' vupui bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu taat gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ dɨ'dɨlhdhɨm gu Jawatan Dios jix koi xidhuu.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu ux gu ñi'ook ja'tkam vaak gu duukam; na jix buusñi gu jodai' bɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt jix duñia'.
Na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na pai' dhuuk tu' gu takarui' vupui bhaan gu ja'tkam na pai' dhuuk gu suudai' gu ux oidha' jix gaki gu Sela.
Jano' ba' gu oidha' jix duñia'; gio ba' gio jix duñia' gu tɨkɨr gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr mii' dhɨr gu Sinaii jix duñia' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' dhuuk jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu maa'nkar; na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Na gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' jix duñia' jix koi; gio ba' gu ux joi'gɨ'nda' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gampai'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ka't jix gɨ' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' jiboi'ññor gu gɨ'kora' chugi'ñ; gio ba' jix duñia' gu vaak gu bhóogɨt gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' xoi'kam jix bɨɨx duu mi'x juu'ñ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oi'ñga'n ka't na ja'p gu oi'ñga'n gioda' iiñat jix toja jodai gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim jix uam jodai.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu jodai' gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' gu chuukug na ja'p jabook gu Salmoon.
Jano' ba' gu kavɨk gu Jawatan Dios gu kavɨk gu Basaan; gio ba' gu kavɨk jix bhai'x gu Basaan.
Jano' ba' gu ux gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu kakkavɨk gu oi'ñga'n dhi' gu kavɨk jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu oi'ñga'n daada'; gio ba' gu Jawatan tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ja'p gu Sinaii xidhuu.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ jix bhai'x gu oi'ñga'n gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x jix bhɨɨ juana' na ba' gu chichio'ñ gio na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ba' jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu Jawatan; gio ba' gu tanoolh gu chuukug gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios gu kutun tulhiiñdha'; mi' dhɨr gu Sela; jano' ba'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios tu' dodhia'; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu oi'ñga'n koi'm.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu bhóogɨt mo'o gu takarui' gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n uañi'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan; gio ba' gu Basaan gu bhóogɨt tu' gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu gɨ' suudai'.
Na gu' na gu' tɨɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ɨ'ɨr gu takarui' nɨɨn gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios gu gɨ'kora' xidhuu.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' vupui bhaan gu suudai'; gio ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu takarui'; gio ba' gu Jawatan gu takarui' gu chuukug gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' ka't gu vaak gu Benjamiin aapi' chiñia' gu Judaa gu takarui' chiñia' gu ñi'ook chiñia' gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duñia' gu kavɨk; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu bhóogɨt no'ch.
Jano' ba' gu ux gu oi'ñga'n vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jerusalem gu gɨ'kora' tu' gu bhóogɨt juana'.
Jano' ba' gu Reprime gu masad chɨbɨɨp gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n tutuur bɨɨx ali' vaakax gu ja'tkam bɨɨx ka'm bɨx gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx gu ñi'ook jix toja jodai; gio ba' gu jodai' gu ja'tkam jugi bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' aajim chiñia' gu Ejipto; gio ba' gu jodai' jix duñia' gu noobh gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha' tɨ'ya' gu Jawatan Dios tɨ'ya' gu Jawatan gu Sela.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' bhaan gu tɨkɨr jix bhai'x; gio ba' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook maa'n gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' bhaan gu Israeel gɨ'x bhai' gu suudai' gu tɨkɨr.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios dɨr vaak na jix bhaan; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel jix maa gu maa'nkar gu chuukug gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' bhaan gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu Salmo gu Dabii; na gu' gu Saalbame gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na gu' gu suudai' jix duñia' kia'mi'ñ bɨɨx ka'm gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' dhi' jix bhai'x gu takarui' jix dhaam suudai' pai' cham cham tu'x jai'ch tɨɨt; gio ba' tɨbiap gu chuukug gu suudai' gu takarui' tu' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jix bhai'x dhi' jup tɨɨt; gio ba' gu ja'tkam tu' gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt gu vupui nɨɨrda' gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oi'ñga'n kuupa'n mo'o gu oi'ñga'n cham kuiñcha; gio ba' jix duñia' gu chuukug gu takarui' gu suudai' cham gu ux gu oi'ñga'n; mi' dhɨr tɨbiap gu ñi'ook cham jix bhɨɨ.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' ñɨidhat gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu jodai' cham tu' gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' cham ka't jum xibhɨ'ñ gu ux kuiñcha tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; gio ba' cham ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel.
Na gu' na gu' gu ux xoi'kam tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu jodai' na jix uam tu' jix bhaan dhaas gu vupui.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu chuukug gu ja'tkam gu tanoolh gu ma'nkam gu naan.
Na gu' na gu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu vaak; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia' ia'rɨ bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu suudai' bɨɨx gu vaak gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' dhi' tu' jix duñia' gu ux gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu suudai' gu ux tɨi'chu'; gio ba' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook bhaan tu' jix duñia' ki'ñgob gu jodai' gu suudai' gu i'ii'ñ gu oi'ñga'n.

Gu' cham gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia' soi'm tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook jix bhai' aagak; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ux gu oi'ñga'n xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu ux tu'r tulhiiñdha' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ cham ka't tu' gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' ka't tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oi'ñga'n jix dhaam suudai' gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' cham gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' tu' gu jodai' gu oi'ñga'n tu' oidha' suudai' gu jodai' bhaan tu' gu chin.
Na gu' gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios na gu' jix bhai'x xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch; gio ba' gu jodai' jurtu'nka' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' cham gu chuukug gu vupui tu duukam; na gu' dhi' jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu i'ii'ñ gu suudai'; gio ba' gu suudai' kuiñcha gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' tu' ñɨidhat gu ja'tkam gu jodai' na jix uam gu jodai'; gio ba' vupui bhaan tu' bɨx obhɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam tu' jix bhai'x gu i'ii'ñ dhi' gu takarui'; gio ba' gu suudai' jugi tu' cham ka't; mi' dhɨr nuukdaidha' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux jugi gu ñi'ook jix maa i'i jɨ'ɨɨk.
Jano' ba' ka't meesa vupui bhaan gu ux jix duñia' na ba' xoi'kam gu ux gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' ka't gu oi'ñga'n gu vupui na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vupui bɨɨx tas gu takarui' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' biiñ bhaan daak i'iich gu duukam gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' ka't gu kutun gu ñi'ook; gio ba' vaak zel cham ka't jix koi.
Na gu' na gu' jix duñia' tu' gu chuukug; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaak tu' gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' tu' na cham jir bhai' bhaan tu' na cham jir bhai' cham kapbhai' bɨx bhai'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu bhóogɨt u'uan na jix do'ig cham ka't gu jodai' bɨɨx jir bhai' ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug tulhiiñdha' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt tu' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx bhai' ñi'ook gu chuukug bɨɨx bhai' ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu oi'ñga'n gu maa'nkar gu vaakax tuur mi'x juu'ñ a'aa' gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' jix duñia'; gio ba' gu suudai' gu Jawatan Dios ii'mdagaram gu i'ii'ñ.
Na gu' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu takarui' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tɨkɨr gu oidha' gu gɨ' suudai' bɨx oidha' bhaan jiim.
Na gu' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios nukadham gu Sioon jix duñia' jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa; gio ba' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu kai' ja'tkam na tu juan jix duñia' gu takarui' gu tɨɨgɨ' jix daa.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' gu ux gu Dabii na ba' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu jodai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; jano' ba' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' ka't jum xibhɨ'ñ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' gu oidha'; gio ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu suudai' jum xibhɨ'ñ cham bhai' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu kutun gu ja'tkam gu kutun tu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu'.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu takarui' tu' gu bhóogɨt tu' jix duñia'; gio ba' gu suudai' bɨɨx tas gu takarui' tulhiiñdha'; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' ka't gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu Yo dhi' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu chuukug tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr u'ua'tɨdham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu chuukug tu'; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios cham tu' gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu duukam; gio ba' cham ka't tu' gu takarui' na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu chuukug gu suudai' bɨx bhai'; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ naak gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu ux gu jodai' na jix uam dhi' gu suudai' gu chuukug tu' jix bhai'x; gio ba' jix aa'ñdhix tu' ka't jix duñia'; na gu' tu' gu chuukug gu jodai' na jix uam gu kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu chuukug gu suudai' gu novɨ jix bhai'x gu novɨ jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' na gu' tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu chuukug nɨɨra; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ dɨr gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ux tu' jix duñia' gu jodai' dɨr vook; gio ba' ba'k gu naan tu' gu ñi'ook jix buusñi; mi' dhɨr tu' ka't bɨɨx tas gu kutun.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim jix duñia' mui'x; gio ba' tu' gu maa'nkar jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' ka't jix bhuup gu chin gu kutun gɇ'kamtu'nda' bɨx gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' cham gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu ux; na pai' dhuuk gu kavɨk gu ñi'ook cham gu takarui'.
Na gu' na gu' obhɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt tu'; gio ba' gu suudai' gu i'ii'ñ jix duñia' bɨɨma'n.
Jano' ba' bham; gio ba' gu takarui' tu' tɨtda:―Cha'pim; na gu' jix duñia' jix bhɨɨ na gu' cham cham tu'x jai'ch namkidhat.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios cham tu' jix duñia' tu'; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu chuukug gu jodai' jootom gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' ka't jum xibhɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ xi'ɨraam gu jodai' na jix uam cham bhai' jix duñia'.
Gu' gu' tu' bɨɨx tas gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oi'ñga'n bhaan bɨx gu kutun.
Jano' ba' gu chin jix duñia' bɨx bhai' tulhiiñdha' bɨx gu tanoolh gu ux cham tu' jɨɨ'ñdhidha'.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu jodai' gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt chɨ'ñchoka' gu duukam bɨx bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu oi'ñga'n dɨr jix duñia'; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm jano' jix duñia' kɨɨ'p.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' bɨɨx ka'm gu ux gu jodai'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios cham gu takarui' bɨɨx ka'm gu suudai' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu jodai' bɨx jix duñia' jix ai.
Jano' ba' bɨx bhai' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx ka'm gu suudai'; na gu' gu ñi'ook tu'x; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chɨkka na ja'p tu'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ mumua'da' gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix maat gu oi'ñga'n gu oidha' jix vɨɨk gu oi'ñga'n gɇ' suudai' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu tasi' jix maat gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' tu' gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu chuukug; gio ba' tu'r jix duñia' tu' gu ñi'ook jix bhaan gu Israeel.
Na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook na pai' dhuuk tu' gu bhóogɨt gu i'ii'ñ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' nɨɨn tu ñi'ook gio bɨx bhai' bɨx gu tanoolh; na gu' jix bɨɨx duu jum xibhɨ'ñ na gu' jix bɨɨx duu gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ cham bhai' jix duñia'.
Na ba' na ba' gu Salomoon; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix maa ñi'ook na jir bhai' gu gɨ'kora' bɨx bhai' gu mar gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam bɨɨx bɨx bhai' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ñi'ook na jir bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu kakkavɨk jix duñia' bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu ja'tkam bɨx bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam u'ua'tɨda' gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tas gu masad gu ux gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' jix dhaav na ja'p dhuuk bhaan gu vaas gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' na ja'p gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n bhaan gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu tanoolh bɨx bhai' gu oi'ñga'n bhai'x i'ii'ñ bɨɨx ka'm cham ka't gu masad.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu gɨ' suudai' dɨr gɨ' suudai' jiim bɨɨx ka'm gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' vupui bhaan jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' obhɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Tarsis gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Seba gu bhóogɨt juana'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' bɨx gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' tu juan bɨx chɨbɨɨp.
Na gu' na gu' jix duñia' gu ja'tkam tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook cham jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gampai' gu ja'tkam u'ua'tɨda' gu i'ii'ñ bia'.
Jano' ba' iatda' gu ñi'ook tu jiim gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' gu ɨ'ɨr ka't dha'ram gu vupui.
Jano' ba' ii'mdagaram maa'n jix uam jodai gu Seba; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ux jix bhai'x; mi' dhɨr bɨx gu tanoolh jix bhai' aa'.
Jano' ba' ka't baas gu ñi'ook kai'ñ gu oidha' gu oi'ñga'n gu kakkavɨk; gio ba' gu i'bhɨ jix duñia' tɨroon na ja'p gu ñi'ook kiicham gu suudai' na ja'p gu vaas gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tɨɨgɨ' na ba' bɨɨx tas jix duñia' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu bhóogɨt gu tas gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka't bɨx chɨbɨɨp; mi' dhɨr jup tɨɨt bhai' ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel gu duukam duñia' kɨɨ'p.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu tɨɨgɨ' tas na jix gɨ' na ba' bɨɨx tas; gio ba' bɨx gu oidha' ka't jix bhuup gɇ'kamtu'nda'; mi' dhɨr gu Ameen.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' ɨlhdhat gu Dabii gu mar gu Isaii.
Jano' ba' gu ux gu Asap; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel gu suudai' gu i'ii'ñ.
Gu' gu' tu' gu maa'nkar jix duñia' tɨɨt; gio ba' gu ux gu vaak jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n.
Na gu' na gu' jix duñia' jɨɨgak gu takarui' ñɨi'ñ gu kutun jix bhai'x.
Na gu' na gu' cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu ñi'ook na ba' koi'm; gio ba' va'k gu kavɨk gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' cham tu jiim gu ja'tkam; gio ba' tu' gɨɨ'bia' bɨɨx gu chichio'ñ.
Na ba' gu ux gu jodai' gu ux kuruun; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt tɨi'chu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu vupui gu takarui' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu suudai' bɨɨx gu takarui' gu chuukug gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' tu ñi'ook bɨɨx tu' na cham jir bhai' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tɨkɨr gu chin nɨɨn gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' jix bhuup gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios cham tu'x jai'ch machia' jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' dhi' ja'tkam jix bhai'x cham gu suudai' gu jodai' oipichu' jix duñia' namkɨm.
Jano' ba' gu vaak gu i'ii'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu i'ii'ñ tooton gu noobh bɨx bhai'.
Na gu' jix duñia' bɨx gu tanoolh jix duñia' sɨlhka'n gu ux sɨlhkam.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook tu' gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' na ba' maachim dhi'; gio ba' gu vupui jix bhai'x tu jiim.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx ka'm tɨbiap xidhuu gu Jawatan Dios gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu takarui' jix duu gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu chuukug gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bɨɨx duu jix duñia' bɨɨx gu takarui'.
Na pai' dhuuk na ja'p gu vaak gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' tu'r gu i'ii'ñ gu chuukug gu suudai' gu jodai'.

Jano' ba' jix maa gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu maa'nkar gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu novɨ bhaamki'ñdha'.

Jano' ba' gu tai jix duñia' biipibop gu jodai' cham jix bɨɨx duu gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan ia'rɨ gu ñi'ook dɨ'dɨlhdhɨm cham jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan tu' gu ñi'ook na ja'p jix kavɨk gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n suudai' u'va.
Jano' ba' naaka'n gu ñi'ook jix duñia'; gio ba' jix maa gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu Josee cham jix duñia' bopxi'ñ gu Epraim.
Gu' gu Sino jix duñia' bopxi'ñ gu Judaa gu kavɨk gu Sioon jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jix duu xidhuu gu oi'ñga'n na ja'p gu oidha' jix duñia' na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Dabii tu duukam jix bhɨɨ gu takarui' kakneer.
Jano' ba' bhaan gu ñi'ook jix bhɨɨ na ba' gu takarui' gu Jakob gu ja'tkam gu Israeel gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' bɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' jix duñia' bɨɨx gu takarui' gu noobh.

Jano' ba' gu ux gu Asap; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tɨɨtɨs chɨbɨɨp gu maa'nkar; mi' dhɨr vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' jix duñia' gu takarui'; jano' ba' jix dhaas gu Jerusalem gɨ' kavɨk.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu chuukug tu duukam gu ux jugi gu u'uvhig gu tɨkɨr; gio ba' gu chuukug jɨɨgi'ñdham gu vaakax gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu ɨ'ɨr na ja'p gu suudai' xikoolh gu Jerusalem; gio ba' cham ka't gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu'ch gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' gu chuukug gu jodai' gu bhóogɨt xikoolh.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx ka'm duuk gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu chuukug gu ñi'ook na ba' bɨɨx tas gu oi'ñga'n na ja'p gu tai gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' biiñ gu vaak bhaan chɨbɨɨp cham tu' gu duukam bhaan oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Na gu' na gu' jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n gu Jakob jix koi jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' cham gu jodai' bhaan gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu ñi'ook jootom gu jodai' na gu' dhi' gu bhóogɨt gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tulhiiñdha' gu kutun gu ñi'ook gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu tɨɨgɨ'; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan gu ux uañi'ñ gu ñi'ook xoi'kam gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Na gu' na gu' gu chuukug chɨbɨɨp; gio ba' duukat gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duñia' chɨbɨɨp vupui bhaan gu vupui gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ɨ'ɨr tu duukam ka't gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ vupui bhaan gu oi'ñga'n gu chuukug ui'ka'; gio ba' jurtu'nka' gu duukam gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ koi'm.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' baaso kɨɨv gu bhóogɨt gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n bɨɨx tu' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' no'ch gu ja'tkam gu oi'ñga'n kakneer gu suudai' tu' gu takarui' na ba' bɨɨx tas; gio ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook gu suudai' bhai' ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' bhaan gu ñi'ook gu jodai'; mi' dhɨr gu ux gu Asap; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook bipia'dam gu Israeel gu chuukug; gio ba' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ja'p kakneer gu Josee gu jodai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai' vupui bhaan gu Epraim gu Benjamiin gu Manasees gu kutun dodhia'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai'; gio ba' gu vupui gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu vupui duduaka' gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ bɨɨx ka'm duuk gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' bhaan soi'm gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jugi gu takarui' suakɨt gu ñi'ook i'i suakɨt gu tasi'.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu ux gu vaak na jix bhai' gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui'; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui' gu chuukug tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai'; gio ba' gu vupui gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu vupui duduaka' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu kutun gu tasi' gu Ejipto; gio ba' mi'x juu'ñ chɨbɨɨp gu ux vaas.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bhuup gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu kakkavɨk jix bɨɨx duu gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ɨkgiga'n; gio ba' gu suudai' na ja'p gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx ka'm gu gɨ' suudai' bɨɨx ka'm gɨ' suudai' jiim gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ux gu oi'ñga'n gu chuukug oidha' bhai' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' gu ux gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gɨ' kavɨk jix duñia' gu vaakax yooxi'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu bhóogɨt jano'; gio ba' gu suudai' dɨr gu tɨkɨr gu ñi'ook dhi' oidha' u'va.
Jano' ba' gu vaas jix dhaas kɨɨ'n gu ñi'ook na ba' tu' gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' vaak na jix bhaan gu tai gu takarui'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu ja'tkam gu vupui.
Jano' ba' ka't gu novɨ bhaan gu chio'ñ kɨɨ'n bhaan gu mar gu chio'ñ na ba' tu' gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' cham gu ñi'ook tu'; gio ba' gu oidha' maa'n gu chuukug gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai'; gio ba' gu vupui gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu vupui duduaka' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' bhaan gu Gittit; mi' dhɨr gu ux gu Asap; jano' ba' tɨ'ya' gu Jawatan Dios gu kavɨk gu kutun; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Jakob jix duñia' bɨɨx gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk gu ja'tkam gu masad gu tanoolh nɨi'ñchudat gu tanoolh gu kutun jix duñia'.
Na gu' na gu' ñi'ook kavɨk gu Israeel jir bɨx bhai' gu Jawatan Dios gu Jakob.
Na pai' dhuuk gu ux chuut gu Josee tu' gu chuukug na pai' dhuuk jix buus gu ux gu oidha' gu Ejipto; na pai' tu' gu suudai' cham gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n bɨtaa'n gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu noobh jix duñia' gu takarui' bhi'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' duuñ tu' gu takarui'; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook ɨxchuixim gu jodai'; mi' dhɨr tu' gu bhóogɨt bhaan gu suudai' gu Meriba; jano' ba' gu Sela; gio ba'.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu ja'tkam gu chuukug tu' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Israeel tu' gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' cham gu oi'ñga'n tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu oi'ñga'n tu' gu chuukug gu Jawatan Dios gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu oi'ñga'n jix tɨ'ɨ gu oidha' gu Ejipto; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu chin gu jodai'.
Gu' gu' gu ja'tkam cham jix kai gu ñi'ook gu Israeel cham gu oi'ñga'n tu'.
Jano' ba' mi'x dhaas gu ux gu jodai' gu oi'ñga'n gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' jix duñia' gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook naak gu ja'tkam tu' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu Israeel gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' cham tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu o'o gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt gu novɨ bhaan gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug; gio ba' gu ñi'ook mai' na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu ñi'ook tiriik; gio ba' suudai' na jix bhai' gu jodai tu' gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu ux gu Asap; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu masad gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx ka'm duuk gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt jix bhai'x gu Sela; gio ba'.
Jano' ba' gu Depended gampai' ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam; gio ba' xoi'kam bɨx bhai' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu novɨ jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' cham gu i'ii'ñ cham gu jodai' gu kutun gu tukgam; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu ñi'ook gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu Yo tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios gu ma'nkam bɨx gu takarui' gu ñi'ook.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu chichio'ñ koi gu chuukug na ja'p no'x gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' bamii' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu oidha'; na gu' tu' gu bhóogɨt bɨx chɨbɨɨp.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' gu ux gu Asap; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ duiñ; jano' ba' cham gu vaak gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook gu suudai'.
Na gu' na gu' gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu suudai' mo'o.
Jano' ba' bhaan gu ja'tkam jix duñia' gu chuukug jix maat gu suudai' jix duñia' kia'mi'ñ gu bhóogɨt bhaan gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' gu ja'tkam cham ka't gu oi'ñga'n chɨ'ñchoka' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu ux dhi' jix duñia' gu jodai' gu i'ii'ñ bhaan tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' ba'r gu chuukug gu Ismaelitas gu Moab gu Agarenos.
Jano' ba' gu Gebal gu Ammoon gu Amalek; gio ba' gu Pilisteos bɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Tiro.
Jano' ba' gio gu Assur tu' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx; gio ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Lot; mi' dhɨr gu Sela; jano' ba'.
Jano' ba' tu jiim na ja'p gu Madiaan; gio ba' na ja'p gu Siisara na ja'p gu Jabiin jix duu gu Kisoon.
Na jix duñia' gu Endor jix bɨɨx duu gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu Oreb na ja'p gu Seeb; gio ba' na ja'p gu Seba na ja'p gu Salmunna bɨx chiñia'.
Na jix duñia' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu jodai' na ba' gu takarui' jix koi gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu chuukug gu takarui' na ja'p gu suudai'; gio ba' na ja'p jajar vupui bhaan gu jɨvɨl.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu tai gu oi'ñga'n gu kavɨk na ja'p mɨmɨim gu jodai' gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' bɨɨx gu suudai' gu chuukug bɨɨx gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu jodai' xi'ɨraam; gio ba' gu suudai' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ka't gu takarui' gu jodai' na ba' bɨɨx tas; gio ba' ka't gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' gu duukam gu Gɨ'kora' Jawatan bhaan bɨx gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' bhaan gu Gittit; mi' dhɨr gu ux na ba' gu ma'nkam gu Koree; jano' ba' gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n jix koi gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu suudai' jix bhai'x gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ gu chuukug gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt bakia' gu vaak gu ux gu ñi'ook na ba' pai' jix duñia' gu suudai' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu gɨ'kora' gu chuukug gu Jawatan Dios gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu vaak; gio ba' jix bhai'x tu' jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr gu Sela; jano' ba'.
Jano' ba' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu chio'ñ juraa'n gu kavɨk tu'; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ gu bhóogɨt.
Na pai' dhuuk gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu suudai' gu Baka gu bhóogɨt gu ux suudai' buusñi na pai' dhuuk dhuuk gu ñi'ook dhi'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Sioon.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu takarui' soi'm; gio ba' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Jakob; mi' dhɨr gu Sela; jano' ba'.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios kutun kavɨk chulhiiñdha' gu takarui' gu vupui maa'n.
Na gu' na gu' tutkɨ gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx gɨ' mai'; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n va'k gu ñi'ook ki'ñgob gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook jix koi tu' na cham jir bhai'.
Na gu' na gu' gu tas kutun kavɨk gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' nɨidhidha' gɇ'kamtu'nda' maa'n gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr cham jix duñia' xoi'kam gu suudai' gu kutun.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ tu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ tu' gu bhóogɨt.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' gu ux na ba' gu ma'nkam gu Koree; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu oidha' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' gu chuukug gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu Jakob.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' tu' na cham jir bhai' gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt uañi'ñ gu oi'ñga'n; mi' dhɨr gu Sela; jano' ba'.
Jano' ba' mi'x dhaas bɨx gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' tu' gu chuukug daak i'iich.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tulhiiñdha' gu kutun gu vupui gu suudai' gu ñi'ook bhaan no'ch.
Jano' ba' dhi' jix bhai'x bhaan no'ch na ba' bɨɨx tas gu suudai' daak gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' cham jix maat tu' gu takarui' gu oidha' gu ja'tkam jix duñia' tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu ñi'ook tulhiiñdha'.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' tu ñi'ook bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu ja'tkam jɨɨgi'ñdham na ba' cham jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook mia'n tulhiiñdha' gu oi'ñga'n; na ba' jix duñia' gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu kutun gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch tu'r jix duñia'; gio ba' bɨx bhai' bhai'x i'ii'ñ jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' tu'r jix duñia' gu oidha'; gio ba' bɨx bhai' jix duñia' dɨr gu tɨkɨr.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios maa'n gio xoi'kam; gio ba' gu kutun gu oidha' maa'n gu i'bhɨ.
Jano' ba' bɨx bhai' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan; gio ba' gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' soi'm gu Dabii; gio ba' gu Inklina gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios naak gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; na gu' dhi' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam.
Na gu' jix nukadham gu i'ii'ñ na gu' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' dodhia' tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu chuukug tu duukam tu' gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' mambhɨɨx xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' tu' tu ñi'ook bɨx gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ tu duukam; na gu' tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu oi'ñga'n gu i'ii'ñ.
Na gu' na gu' tu' gu Jawatan gu chuukug jix bhai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix gɨ' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch na ba' bɨɨx bɨx tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix kai gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios soi'm gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu suudai'.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tanoolh gu chuukug tu' mɨmɨim; na gu' tu' tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ cham tu'x jai'ch na ja'p tu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios tu' buimɨi gu takarui' buimɨi.
Jano' ba' bɨx chɨbɨɨp gu oi'ñga'n aajim jix duñia' vupui bhaan tu' gu Jawatan; gio ba' tas na jix gɨ' gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Na gu' na gu' tu' gu chuukug jix gɨ' gu ja'tkam kɨɨ'p; gio ba' tu' gu duukam gu chuukug gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt tu' tu'r; mi' dhɨr gu chuukug gu i'ii'ñ na ba' gu Tema gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu chuukug bɨɨx bɨx gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' tas na jix gɨ' gu tɨɨgɨ' na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Na gu' na gu' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch jix gɨ' na ba' gu chuukug; gio ba' gu takarui' gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook jix dhaam suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix búup bhaan tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix kavɨk tu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu i'ii'ñ cham tu' jix dhaas vupui bhaan.
Gu' gu' tu' gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios i'ii'ñ na jix xoi'kam gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n na ba' daak jix gɨ' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch tu'r.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' mambhɨɨx xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch tu'; gio ba' jix maa gu maa'nkar tu duukam jix nukadham gu mar gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios.
Jano' ba' gu vupui gu chuukug nɨi'ñchudat na ba' xoi'kam gu oi'ñga'n ka't jum xibhɨ'ñ; na gu' tu' gu Jawatan Dios u'ua'tɨdham gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Koree; gio ba' gu ux; mi' dhɨr gu oi'ñga'n; jano' ba' gu suudai' gu kakkavɨk jix bhaan Gɨ'kora'.
